scope_note: This identifies a 1970 article explicitly addressing cognitive therapy's relation to behavior therapy; it does not itself prove a completed merger.
statement: Aaron T. Beck published 'Cognitive therapy: Nature and relation to behavior therapy' in 1970 in Behavior Therapy, volume 1, pages 184–200.
statement_zh: Aaron T. Beck 於 1970 年在《Behavior Therapy》第 1 卷 184–200 頁發表〈Cognitive therapy: Nature and relation to behavior therapy〉。
